content.text:
Perfect! I now have a comprehensive overview. Let me compile my findings:

## CabinetMaker Solution - Complete Overview

### 1. Projects & Purpose

All projects target **.NET 10.0**:

- **CabinetMaker.Domain** - Domain entities and repository interfaces
- **CabinetMaker.Domain.Shared** - Shared settings, DTOs, and POCOs
- **CabinetMaker.DAL** - Data Access Layer with DbContext, migrations, and repositories
- **CabinetMaker.BRL** - Business Rules Layer with services and DI configuration
- **CabinetMaker.Web** - Blazor Server web application with Razor components and identity

### 2. Domain Entities (CabinetMaker.Domain/Entities)

**Core Base Classes:**
- `CmEntity` - Base class with audit fields: CreatedDate, CreatedUserId, LastUpdatedDate, LastUpdatedUserId, RecordStateId
- `CmEntityHistory` - Extends CmEntity, adds EffectiveDate, ObsoleteDate (for temporal records)
- `ITenantScoped` - Interface requiring TenantId (multi-tenancy support)
- `ITemporalRecord` - Interface for temporal data

**Dictionary/Reference Data:**
- `CmType` (TypeID, TypeClassID, Name, Description, Ordering, TypeInt, TypeString, TypeDecimal)
- `CmTypeClass` (CmTypeClassID, Name, Description, BaseTypeID, DefaultValue)
- `CmUnit` (UnitID, Name, Abbreviation, IsSystemBase, BaseMultiplier, DisplayPrecision, UnitTypeID)
- `CmMeasurement` (CmMeasurmentId, UnitId, RawValue, Unit navigation)

**Plans/Subscriptions:**
- `Plan` (PlanId, PlanGuid, Name, Slug, IsPubliclyVisible, SortOrder)
- `PlanDetail` (PlanDetailId, PlanDetailGuid, PlanId, DisplayName, Tagline, MonthlyPrice, AnnualPrice, PriceDisplayOverride) - extends CmEntityHistory

**Tenancy/Identity:**
- `Tenant` (TenantId, TenantGuid, Name, Slug, IsActive, PlanId)
- `TenantSettings` (TenantSettingsId, TenantSettingsGuid, TenantId, ShopHourlyRate, DefaultMarkupPercentage, DefaultMarginPercentage)
- `User` - Extends IdentityUser<int> (UserGuid, TenantId, DisplayName)
- `UserPreference` (UserPreferenceId, UserPreferenceGuid, UserId, PreferenceTypeId, TypeInt, TypeString, TypeDecimal)

**Contacts:**
- `Contact` (ContactId, ContactGuid, TenantId, Prefix, FirstName, LastName, Suffix) - implements ITenantScoped
- `ContactMethod` (ContactMethodId, ContactMethodGuid, ContactId, TenantId, ContactTypeId, ContactValue, PreferedContactMethod) - implements ITenantScoped
- `ContactNote` (ContactNoteId, ContactNoteGuid, ContactId, TenantId, Note) - extends CmEntityHistory, implements ITenantScoped

**Materials/Inventory:**
- `CmMaterial` (CmMaterialId)
- `CmMaterialDetail` (CmMaterialDetailId, Name, Description) - extends CmEntityHistory
- `CmMaterialAttribute` (CmMaterialAttributreId, CmMaterialId, AttributeTypeId, MeasurementId, StringValue, BoolValue)
- `MaterialTenantDetail` (MaterialTenantDetailId, MaterialTenantDetailGuid, TenantId, MaterialId, IsHidden, OverrideName, OverrideUnitCost, OverrideWasteFactorPercentage) - extends CmEntityHistory, implements ITenantScoped
- `MaterialTenantAttribute` (MaterialTenantAttributeId, MaterialTenantAttributeGuid, TenantId, MaterialId, AttributeTypeId, MeasurementId, StringValue, BoolValue) - extends CmEntityHistory, implements ITenantScoped

**Jobs & Assembly:**
- `Job` (JobId, JobGuid, TenantId, Name, ClientContactId, JobStatusTypeId, TargetDate, Notes) - implements ITenantScoped
- `CmAssembly` (AssemblyId, AssemblyGuid, TenantId, JobId, Name, OverallHeightMeasurementId, OverallWidthMeasurementId, OverallDepthMeasurementId) - implements ITenantScoped
- `Part` (PartId, PartGuid, TenantId, AssemblyId, Name, Quantity, CutLengthMeasurementId, CutWidthMeasurementId, MaterialId) - implements ITenantScoped
- `PartOperation` (PartOperationId, PartOperationGuid, TenantId, PartId, OperationTypeId, Face, OperationParametersJson) - implements ITenantScoped

**Estimates:**
- `JobEstimate` (JobEstimateId, JobEstimateGuid, TenantId, JobId, EstimateStatusTypeId, Version, GeneratedAt, SentAt, ShopHourlyRate, MarkupPercentage, TotalCost, Notes) - implements ITenantScoped
- `JobEstimateLine` (JobEstimateLineId, JobEstimateLineGuid, TenantId, JobEstimateId, PartId, TenantDiscountCodeId, LineTypeId, Description, Quantity, UnitCost, TotalCost, SortOrder) - implements ITenantScoped
- `TenantDiscountCode` (TenantDiscountCodeId, TenantDiscountCodeGuid, TenantId, Code, Description, DiscountTypeId, DiscountValue, ExpiresAt, MaxUses, UsageCount) - implements ITenantScoped

### 3. Pages/Components in CabinetMaker.Web

**Layout Components:**
- `App.razor` - Root component
- `MainLayout.razor` - Main layout wrapper
- `NavMenu.razor` - Navigation menu
- `ReconnectModal.razor` - Reconnection UI
- `Routes.razor` - Route configuration
- `_Imports.razor` - Global imports

**Pages:**
- `Home.razor` - Home page (minimal placeholder)
- `Error.razor` - Error page
- `NotFound.razor` - 404 page
- `AuthTest.razor` - Authorized test page

**Auth Components:**
- `RedirectToLogin.razor` - Login redirect handler
- `RedirectToUpgrade.razor` - Upgrade redirect handler
- `MfaReminder.razor` - MFA reminder component

**Account/Identity Pages (in Components/Account):**
- `Login.razor` - Login form
- `LoginMfa.razor` - MFA login
- `Manage/TwoFactorAuthentication.razor` - 2FA management
- `Manage/EnableAuthenticator.razor` - Authenticator setup
- `Manage/Disable2fa.razor` - Disable 2FA
- `Shared/StatusMessage.razor` - Status message display

### 4. Services & Repositories

**CabinetMaker.DAL:**
- **DbContext**: `CmContext` (/workspace/src/CabinetMaker.DAL/Context/CmContext.cs)
  - Extends IdentityDbContext<User, IdentityRole<int>, int>
  - 18 DbSets (see below)
  - UTC DateTime enforcement
  - Automatic audit field stamping (CreatedDate, LastUpdatedDate)
  
- **Repositories**: 
  - `IRepository<T>` interface - GetAsync, GetAsync(id), UpdateAsync, AddAsync, DeleteAsync (both overloads)
  - `BaseRepository<T>` - Implements IRepository (stub implementations)
  - `UnitRepository` - Extends BaseRepository<CmUnit>

**CabinetMaker.BRL:**
- `DbSeeder` - Seeds roles (Admin, TenantAdmin, User) and admin user
- Extension classes for DI configuration

### 5. DbContext DbSets (CmContext)

```
// Dictionary & Units
Types, TypeClasses, Units, Measurements

// Plans
Plans, PlanDetails, PlanAttributes

// Identity & Tenancy
Tenants, TenantSettings, UserPreferences

// Contacts
Contacts, ContactMethods, ContactNotes

// Materials
Materials, MaterialDetails, MaterialAttributes, 
MaterialTenantDetails, MaterialTenantAttributes

// Jobs & Assemblies
Jobs, Assemblies, Parts, PartOperations

// Estimates
JobEstimates, JobEstimateLines, DiscountCodes
```

**Total: 21 DbSets**

### 6. Shared Configuration

**CabinetMaker.Domain.Shared:**
- `CmSettings` - Root config (DatabaseProvider, ConnectionStrings, Seed config)
- `CmDbSettings` - Database connection settings
- `CmSeedSettings` - Seed data config (AdminEmail, AdminPassword, AdminDisplayName)
- `CmTypePoco` - DTO for CmType with navigation data
- `UserSummaryPoco` - User summary DTO

### Technology Stack
- **Framework**: .NET 10.0, Blazor Server
- **ORM**: Entity Framework Core 10.0.12
- **Identity**: ASP.NET Core Identity
- **Database**: MySQL (primary), SQL Server support
- **Mapping**: Riok.Mapperly 4.3.1
- **Other**: QRCoder 1.4.3 (for 2FA QR codes)
